# Test pe eval command functionality

env PE_TEST_MODE=true

# Test basic evaluation
exec cat > eval-config.yaml <<'EOF'
description: "Basic evaluation test"
prompts:
  - "What is 2+2?"
providers:
  - name: "mock"
    config:
      model: "test-model"
tests:
  - vars: {}
    assert:
      - type: contains
        value: "4"
EOF

exec pe eval eval-config.yaml
! stderr 'error'

# Test evaluation with variables
exec cat > var-config.yaml <<'EOF'
description: "Variable evaluation test"
prompts:
  - "Hello {{.name}}"
providers:
  - name: "mock"
tests:
  - vars:
      name: "Alice"
    assert:
      - type: contains
        value: "Alice"
EOF

exec pe eval var-config.yaml
! stderr 'error'

# Test with override variables
exec pe eval var-config.yaml --var name=Bob
! stderr 'error'

# Test different output formats
exec pe eval eval-config.yaml --output json
! stderr 'error'

exec pe eval eval-config.yaml --output yaml
! stderr 'error'

exec pe eval eval-config.yaml --output table
! stderr 'error'

# Test verbose mode
exec pe eval eval-config.yaml --verbose
! stderr 'error'

# Test concurrency settings
exec pe eval eval-config.yaml --max-concurrency 1
! stderr 'error'

exec pe eval eval-config.yaml --max-concurrency 3
! stderr 'error'

# Test filter flag
exec pe eval eval-config.yaml --filter test
! stderr 'error'

# Test with nonexistent config file
! exec pe eval nonexistent.yaml
stderr 'error'

# Test without config file (should look for defaults)
! exec pe eval
stderr .

# Test multiple test cases
exec cat > multi-config.yaml <<'EOF'
description: "Multiple test cases"
prompts:
  - "Test prompt 1"
  - "Test prompt 2"
providers:
  - name: "mock"
tests:
  - vars: {}
    assert:
      - type: contains
        value: "test"
  - vars: {}
    assert:
      - type: contains
        value: "Mock"
EOF

exec pe eval multi-config.yaml
! stderr 'error'

# Test dry run mode
exec pe eval eval-config.yaml --dry-run
! stderr 'error'
